title: Minimax ATE Estimation under Gaussian Covariates and Logistic Assignment Tails
banked_reason: Sound evaluated Gaussian-logistic Lipschitz ATE frontier; D0.5.G subfield below field floor, projected paper-score ceiling 7 < 7.4, not salvageable within scope; independent validity gate confirms downgraded bank.
gap_reasons: The exact evaluation concerns the recovery radius; minimax risk and honest interval length are established up to universal constants, and the framing preserves that distinction without leaving the advertised moving-window result conjectural. Relative to [MDWB](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2301.06240) and [Ma–Huang–Namkoong](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.22003), the contribution is the evaluated Gaussian-logistic population frontier, rather than a new general recovery or bias-aware inference framework. Leading-journal significance is constrained by the single known Gaussian design, public propensity slope, and fixed bounded Lipschitz response class. The practical calibration case stops at an oracle-based termination construction: the delivered package contains no executed certified implementation or finite-sample comparison demonstrating benefits for the cited trimming and debiasing workflows. Undefined occurrences of k in the Gaussian-boundary proof require correction to the intended ν, but this is a local notation repair rather than an unresolved statistical step; the narrow benchmark and undemonstrated practical calibration constrain the projected score. proof_attempt_summary: D0 discharged the exact Gaussian-logistic Lipschitz ATE recovery-radius profile, constant-factor minimax risk and honest-length bounds, moving-window regimes, and oracle/rational certification on the original Bernoulli experiment. The source-matching block for Pinsker was cleared by exact-book attestation, and the local undefined-k notation was corrected to nu=b+s. Decision and mathematics panels passed, but D0.5.G capped the delivered package at subfield (score ceiling 7 < 7.4); an independent validity gate confirmed no bounded same-topic route to field, so formalization was not launched.
tldr: Known Gaussian covariates and public logistic assignment identify the original-population ATE at every finite slope. The exponential--line--cap optimizer and scalar information root exactly evaluate its recovery radius, and \(\rho\) gives constant-factor minimax squared risk for every randomized estimator and expected length of honest connected intervals on the exact Bernoulli original-record experiment. A legal Bernoulli testing pair proves the converse; deterministic original-record weights attain the upper orders. At \(b=\sqrt{\log n}\), \(\rho\sim K(1)n^{-(\sqrt3-1)^2}(\log n)^{1-\sqrt3}\). The normal-CDF elbow is centered by \(3b_{\mathrm c}^2/2+2\log b_{\mathrm c}+\log(8\kappa)=\log n\), has width of order one in \(b\), and the formulas cover all moving intermediate windows and the capped limit \(b/\log n\to\beta\in(0,1]\). Both risk and honest length vanish exactly when \(b_n=o(\log n)\). Finite oracle queries and rational operations provide relative-error rate enclosures and honest original-data outputs. The publication kernel is the same-class evaluated frontier and moving elbow; generic modulus/testing and bias-aware inference are supporting transfers. The benchmark calibrates original-ATE trimming and debiasing workflows without asserting empirical membership or software attainment.
gap: MDWB's RKHS attainment and Ma--Huang--Namkoong's fixed-population finite-design Gaussian modulus leave an evaluated frontier for the exact global Lipschitz Gaussian-population Bernoulli experiment unresolved. A fixed efficiency moment or common polynomial propensity-tail envelope does not characterize the changing-slope family uniformly.
fill: Derive an explicit nontrivial branch with all logarithmic factors and its matching legal Bernoulli Le Cam pair, then eliminate the whole-line response geometry into a scalar formula across every crossover and saturation branch. Transfer the same scale to original-record estimation and honest connected intervals; certify the evaluation for reproducible original-ATE bias-correction and coverage benchmarks.
